description: This file contains utility functions for creating, copying, and managing MPSImage and MPSTemporaryImage objects in Metal, specifically for use with PyTorch's ATen library. It includes functions for creating static and temporary images, copying images to buffers, and interfacing with Metal command encoders.

methods.name: createStaticImage
methods.description: Creates an MPSImage with specified sizes.

methods.name: createStaticImage
methods.description: Creates an MPSImage from a source float array and sizes.

methods.name: createStaticImage
methods.description: Creates an MPSImage from a MPSTemporaryImage, copying data from the temporary image.

methods.name: createTemporaryImage
methods.description: Creates a temporary MPSImage with specified sizes.

methods.name: createTemporaryImage
methods.description: Creates a temporary MPSImage from source data and sizes.

methods.name: createTemporaryImage
methods.description: Creates a temporary MPSImage from an existing MPSImage.

methods.name: copyImageToFloatBuffer
methods.description: Copies image data to a float buffer.

methods.name: copyImageToMetalBuffer
methods.description: Copies image data to a Metal buffer.
